g.text: PF-G. Observed versus GALE-CAST Model-W1-forecast values (counts of cases per cell, 1:1 line dashed)
Evidence A: website historical scorecard cases (overall evidence)
Model: deployed GALE-CAST Model-W1 (SHA-256 f2db5aa9…9d14b0), historical scoring procedure (_w1_recall_floor.py: pooled scaled_weather inputs, 32-day
windows); X1 = same-date mean of the three stations' scores; warning if X1 ≥ 0.601 (threshold unchanged).
Cases: website cases with a raw observation of the variable on the target date. Values beyond the plotted range are counted in the end cells. Rainfall
cells are uneven (0, 0.1, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100 mm). Truth: raw, unimputed PAGASA observations.
A useful forecast concentrates cases along the 1:1 line; this figure shows spread, not skill relative to baselines (see PF-F, PF-F3).
